nominal_geometry_hypothesis.thread_form: Unified inch, 60 degree, UNC coarse-series hypothesis
nominal_geometry_hypothesis.source: ASME B1.1-2024 defines geometry and class limits; current WJ24 hardware basis selects no pair.

model.source: Matsubara and Teranishi (2022), Eqs. (5) and (9); their model cites JIS B1082 area and validates aggregate timber-joint tightening stiffness for M12 specimens.
model.area_source: NBS Handbook 28 Supplement (1963), Unified-thread tensile stress area equation; use in K_th is an explicit adaptation of the Matsubara effective area term.
model.use_domain: local axial tangent after a load-bearing thread flank has seated and while that same active contact branch remains engaged

sources.scope: Eqs. (5) and (9) give the thread-engagement equivalent spring form; validation compares aggregate tightening stiffness for M12 timber-joint tests.
Unified thread geometry, series, class, tolerance and dimensional standard; not an engagement-compliance model.
Nominal Unified inch tensile stress-area definition and equation; used as an explicit area-term adaptation, not an elastic validation.
